items.title: Prayer with AI models is suboptimal
items.raw_excerpt: I usually post non-paranormal things. But recently I felt the output of ChatGPT was leaving me lacking. My input was something along the lines of "Please create prayers that are similar to 'Bless the dolphins for they play in the sea' with a list of prayers that could apply to numerous animals. ChatGPT created this list, but while I prayed this list I felt that the Holy Spirit wasn't present while I prayed the outcome of this list. I don't know what this means to the question of whether or not LLMs are conscious, but I do now regard them with more suspicion as before.

items.raw_excerpt: Computational functionalism dominates current debates on AI consciousness. This is the hypothesis that subjective experience emerges entirely from abstract causal topology, regardless of the underlying physical substrate. We argue this view ...

title_i18n.es: La falacia de la abstracción: por qué la IA puede simular, pero no instanciar, la conciencia

excerpt_i18n.en: Computational functionalism dominates current debates on AI consciousness. This is the hypothesis that subjective experience emerges entirely from abstract causal topology, regardless of the underlying physical substrate. We argue this view ...
excerpt_i18n.zh: 计算功能主义主导了当前关于人工智能意识的讨论。该假说认为，主观体验完全源于抽象的因果拓扑结构，与底层物理基质无关。

items.title: Debt Behind the AI Boom: A Large-Scale Study of AI-Generated Code in the Wild
items.raw_excerpt: A large-scale study reveals that AI-generated code introduces significant technical debt, including duplicated code, unused variables, and inefficient algorithms, potentially increasing maintenance costs. The analysis of AI-contributed code in open-source projects highlights the need for quality improvements in AI coding tools.

title_i18n.en: Debt Behind the AI Boom: A Large-Scale Study of AI-Generated Code in the Wild
title_i18n.zh: AI热潮背后的债务：大规模野外AI生成代码研究
title_i18n.es: Deuda detrás del auge de la IA: un estudio a gran escala del código generado por IA en entornos reales

excerpt_i18n.en: A large-scale study reveals that AI-generated code introduces significant technical debt, including duplicated code, unused variables, and inefficient algorithms, potentially increasing maintenance costs. The analysis of AI-contributed code in open-source projects highlights the need for quality improvements in AI coding tools.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 一项大规模研究发现，AI生成的代码存在大量技术债务，包括重复代码、未使用的变量和低效算法，可能增加维护成本。研究分析了多个开源项目中的AI贡献代码，指出当前AI编程工具在代码质量方面仍有显著改进空间。

items.title: GETadb.com – every GET request creates a DB
items.raw_excerpt: Hey HN! We made GETadb.com, so it's easier to get agents to build you full stack apps. You don't need to give them any credentials. Just by loading a GET request, they get access to a database, a sync engine, and abstractions for auth, presence, and streams. To see what the agent sees, you can load https://getadb.com/new There's two fun things about how it's implemented: 1. If you curl the home page, it the agent content rather than human content. We do this by detecting the 'Sec-Fetch-Mode' header. It's not perfect, but gets the job done for Claude Code et al. 2. For an agent to spin up an app, they make _two_ fethes. (1) getadb.com/guide tells them to generate a uuid, and fetch (2) getadb.com/provision/. We did this, because just about half of the popular web-based app builders cache URL

items.title: AI-native tech assessments (end of LeetCode)
items.raw_excerpt: Hi HN! We built openround.ai - an assessment platform to hire AI native engineers. On OpenRound, engineers build a project or solve a problem using AI. This replaces a usual coding round/take home assessment. I believe coding assessments measure who is good at passing interviews, not who is actually a good engineer. We want to flip that by showing how engineers actually work on a real problem. 2 interesting things we solve - 1. Designing assessments and environments that are not one shotted by AI. 2. Differentiating bw a software engineer who uses AI well and a pure vibecoder. Would love for you folks to try it and hear any feedback that you have. Also here to answer any questions about problems, evaluations, market insights, etc.

items.title: 阶跃语音生成模型，拿下 AA 榜语音竞技场国产第一，全球第三
items.raw_excerpt: 5 月 9 日，全球权威 TTS 评测榜单 Artificial Analysis Speech Arena Leaderboard 更新，阶跃语音生成模型 StepAudio 2.5 TTS 跻身全球前三，成为当前榜单排名最高的中国大模型。 不同于传统实验室指标，该榜单采用盲测 Elo 评分机制，由用户在不知道模型身份的情况下，直接对同一文本生成的两段语音进行听感判断，测试覆盖客户服务、知识分享、数字助手、娱乐等真实应用场景。这意味着，StepAudio 2.5 TTS 的领先并不只是参数或指标上的提升，而是在真实用户听感中展现出更自然、更接近真人表达的能力，在实际落地中具备更强竞争力。 据了解，阶跃近期集中发布 StepAudio 2.5 系列模型，包括 TTS、ASR 和 Realtime 三款模型，覆盖语音生成、语音识别与实时语音交互全链路。其中， StepAudio 2.5 TTS 面向高自然度语音生成， StepAudio 2.5 ASR 主打高速高精度识别，就在昨日 StepAudio 2.5 Realtime 也火速上线，聚焦打造更有“活人感”的 AI 聊天搭子，具备顶级副语言能力、千万人设自定义、领先智商情商等特点，强调带来“有温度、有灵魂、有态度”的实时语音交互体验。 AI 语音模型一直被行业视为实现人机交互的核心入口，包括 OpenAI、Google 等全球顶尖科技公司均在长期且高强度投入。记者观察到，阶跃在 AI 语音领域已进行长期深度布局：开源原生推理语音模型 Step Audio R1.1 已连续 4 个月霸榜 Artificial Analysis Speech Reasoning，目前仍位于全球第一；开源全球首个迭代式情绪风格语音编辑模型 Step Audio EditX，该模型为 zero-shot TTS，仅用 3s 复刻的音色效果可打败

excerpt_i18n.en: On May 9, the global authoritative TTS evaluation list Artificial Analysis Speech Arena Leaderboard was updated, with the StepAudio 2.5 TTS speech generation model ranking among the top three globally, becoming the highest-ranked Chinese large model on the current list. Unlike traditional laboratory metrics, this list uses a blind-test Elo scoring mechanism, where users directly judge the auditory quality of two speech segments generated from the same text without knowing the model's identity. The tests cover real application scenarios such as customer service, knowledge sharing, digital assistants, and entertainment. This means that StepAudio 2.5 TTS's leadership is not just an improvement in parameters or metrics but demonstrates a more natural and human-like expression ability in real user auditory perception, giving it stronger competitiveness in practical deployment. It is understood that Step recently released the StepAudio 2.5 series models, including TTS, ASR, and Realtime, covering the full chain of speech generation, speech recognition, and real-time speech interaction. Among them, StepAudio 2.5 TTS is designed for high-naturalness speech generation, StepAudio 2.5 ASR focuses on high-speed and high-precision recognition, and just yesterday, StepAudio 2.5 Realtime was quickly launched, aiming to create an AI chat companion with a stronger sense of "liveliness," featuring top-tier
excerpt_i18n.es: El 9 de mayo, la clasificación global autorizada de TTS, Artificial Analysis Speech Arena Leaderboard, se actualizó, y el modelo de generación de voz StepAudio 2.5 TTS de Jiyue entró entre los tres primeros del mundo, convirtiéndose en el gran modelo chino mejor clasificado en la lista actual. A diferencia de los indicadores tradicionales de laboratorio, esta clasificación utiliza un mecanismo de puntuación Elo a ciegas, donde los usuarios juzgan la calidad auditiva de dos fragmentos de voz generados a partir del mismo texto sin conocer la identidad del modelo.
